source: Ticket 238 and #142 'What the player sees and hears' (the HUD hint chip names what the cell needs and what the miner has), in #159's ledger voice (the Guild quartermaster's ledger, section 4). Extractors go by name, never 'rig' (#159 Game Director naming ruling), so the ticket's 'tether rig required' reads 'Aether Tether required'. {need} and {have} take the numbers of gate_hit's required and have, {price} its dock price (D4 #863: blast-only rock names the charge type that breaks it and says the miner carries one or what it costs, never that it is locked); {extractor} takes the extractor's name. Every template passes #159's flavour rules. The chip holds for chipShowTicks (3 s at 60 ticks a second; a starting value for Gameplay & Vehicle, #142 open questions), once per cell per dive.
drill: Ledger: drill tip {need} required, the miner has {have}.
dynamite: Ledger: a type {need} charge breaks this rock, the miner carries one.
dynamiteAtDock: Ledger: a type {need} charge breaks this rock, {price} at the dock.

extractorMissing.drifted: Ledger: {extractor} required, the lump drifted off.

extractorAtWork.tuned: Ledger: {extractor} tuning, hold the miner still.
extractorAtWork.etched: Ledger: {extractor} etching, dig elsewhere a while.
extractorAtWork.canister: Ledger: {extractor} canisters spent, the ore vented.
extractorAtWork.free_cable: Ledger: {extractor} cable busy, the lump drifted off.
